{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern suggests prioritizing tests for early failure feedback. In this workflow, the 'fast' job runs both 'offline tests' (pytest -m 'not slow') and 'lint and type-check' (make lint). Since linting and type-checking are typically much faster and catch syntax/type errors that would cause tests to fail anyway, I will reorder the steps to run 'Lint and type-check' before 'Run offline tests'. This provides faster feedback on code quality and structural errors before executing the test suite.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fast:
    name: Fast tests and lint (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Lint and type-check
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} make lint
      - name: Run offline tests
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} pytest -m 'not slow' tests/

  browsers:
    name: All-backend browser tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python 3.12 --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: uv run playwright install chromium --with-deps
      - name: Run browser tests against local fixtures
        run: uv run pytest -vv tests/browsers/

  wheel:
    name: Build wheel for isolated extras checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build wheel
        run: uv build --wheel
      - name: Upload wheel
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist/*.whl
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  installed-extras:
    name: Installed wheel (${{ matrix.extra }})
    needs: wheel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        extra: [base, httpx, playwright, all]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download built wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist
      - name: Check wheel in isolated environment
        run: python scripts/check_wheel.py dist/*.whl --extra ${{ matrix.extra }}
"
}
